entries.title: Unfitted Darcy trace refinement
entries.refinement: Fixed 16 macro triangles, local P8/r4; trace P1 with s=1,2,4
entries.summary: Pressure and Darcy-flux errors decrease across three trace partitions.
entries.limitations: Trace refinement with fixed local discretization; macro convergence and the complete literature study are not asserted.

entries.title: PGMHM enriched pressure and Darcy flux
entries.refinement: P3 locals/P1 traces; alpha=0.1; macro n=2,4,8
entries.summary: Three initial smooth-problem resolutions have decreasing enriched field errors.
entries.limitations: Raw broken gradient flux; only the enriched normal multiplier is macro conservative. This declared triangular smooth problem does not reproduce a historical polygonal computation.

entries.title: UNUSUAL reaction-diffusion
entries.refinement: P1 locals/P0 traces; local r=2; macro n=2,4,8
entries.summary: Separate scalar and diffusion-flux errors decrease on three smooth-problem meshes.
entries.limitations: Epsilon=1 analytical control with stated strong Dirichlet and zero Neumann data; no singular-perturbation rate is inferred.

entries.title: SPE10 Model 2, layer 36
entries.refinement: Fixed 6x11 macros and continuous P1/s2 trace; Q1 local r=4,8,16
entries.summary: Pressure increments decrease; relative Darcy-flux increments exceed unity and increase.
entries.limitations: The three local resolutions do not establish flux convergence or a converged numerical reference. The r2 local/trace pairing is excluded by a rank-8 coupling with 12 trace columns. No exact solution or same-operator converged conforming reference is supplied.

entries.title: Quarter obstacle classical reference refinement
entries.refinement: Existing conforming NeoPZ RT0/P0 levels r=4,8,16,32
entries.summary: Three successive physical pressure and Darcy-flux increments decrease on four classical meshes.
entries.limitations: A fine numerical reference retains nonzero refinement error; it is not an exact or certified converged solution. Original native revision, basis and provenance are retained; the historical article reproduction is not asserted.

entries.title: Mixed Darcy well, two accepted levels
entries.refinement: Fixed octagonal annulus and macro factor 1; tetrahedral H(div)/P1, F=1,2
entries.summary: Two accepted resolutions have completed pressure and Darcy-flux norms; F4 did not close within its resource limit.
entries.limitations: Only two of three requested levels are accepted; no three-level convergence rate is asserted. Fixed polygonal geometry, measured physical fine-cell diameters; this is not the historical curved mesh. The initial joint phase and the separate F4 phase each stopped at the 60-second bound.

entries.title: Helmholtz plane wave
entries.refinement: Spatial n=8,12,16; Q 4/r 2, face P 2
entries.summary: Exact pressure errors 5.306e-3 to 3.291e-4 and gradient errors 0.5076 to 0.06821.
entries.limitations: Three initial levels do not establish asymptotic rates or the full angular/stability studies Cartesian local Q4 spaces are the declared analytical variant; every published mesh has not been identified

entries.title: Equation (53) analytical elastic wave
entries.refinement: Spatial n=1,2,3; vector P 3/r 2, face P 1; dt=0.005, final time 0.025 s
entries.summary: Separate displacement, velocity and stress errors decrease over all three initial levels.
entries.limitations: Five time steps give an initial spatial study; the original .5s horizon and asymptotic rates remain outside this acquisition Temporal error is included in each analytical field error

entries.title: Maxwell nanoguide: independent DG study
entries.refinement: DG Q 2 n=16,32,64; complete device; H time 5.0, E time 5.0025
entries.summary: Electric increments decrease 1.485 to 0.2692 and magnetic increments 1.998 to 0.2964 against n 64.
entries.limitations: n64 is a numerical comparison level, not an exact or resolved reference The shortened horizon includes the beginning of device interaction; the full11.31 observation remains outside this study Historical source phase/turn-on conventions remain unidentified No MHM/native whole-trajectory agreement is claimed by this DG-only study

entries.title: Three layers: conforming temporal study
entries.refinement: Fixed continuous vector P 3, h=8 m; dt=0.004/0.002/0.001 s, final time 0.3 s
entries.summary: Displacement increments decrease 5.490e-8 to 1.101e-8 and velocity increments 5.695e-6 to 1.155e-6.
entries.limitations: Spatial refinement of h8 is unresolved; temporal increments do not certify spatial accuracy dt.001 is a numerical comparison level, not an exact temporal solution This conforming temporal study does not replace a complete MHM/refined-reference physical comparison Selected mesh, horizons and Ormsby data do not identify the historical author's inputs

entries.title: Marmousi: explicit 160x 80 m crop pilot
entries.refinement: Macro H=80/40/20 m; Q 3/P 1; fixed 2.5 m fine mesh on primary SI data
entries.summary: Pressure increments decrease 9795 to 959.7 against the H 20 numerical comparison level.
entries.limitations: The crop changes lateral/bottom boundary locations; the full selected paper domain remains outside this pilot Fine spacing is fixed at2.5m; the study measures macro trace restriction and does not establish continuum spatial convergence The finest MHM field is a numerical comparison level; it is not an exact or resolved reference Primary SEG data are identified; the historical article arrays remain unidentified

entries.title: Random-coefficient transport: initial temporal increments
entries.refinement: Fixed 2048 triangles and CGP3; dt=0.001, 0.0005, 0.00025; T=0.005
entries.summary: Concentration L2 and gradient increments decrease when the time step is halved.
entries.limitations: Three time steps give two own temporal increments at T=0.005 on one 2048-triangle mesh. Spatial reference accuracy and the complete T=7 trajectory remain unresolved. The unstabilized CGP3 field has negative nodal concentrations; no positivity clipping is applied. These increments are neither exact errors nor certified continuum bounds or transferred smooth-problem rates.

entries.title: Periodic coefficient: Q1 increments and MHM local sensitivity
entries.refinement: Q1 n=256..4096; fixed macro8x8/P0 MHM local r128/256, s=1..32
entries.summary: Q1 increments decrease; full H1 and MHM local increments still show unresolved field accuracy.
entries.limitations: The Q1 finest-pair relative increments are approximately 0.99 percent in L2 and 9.77 percent in full H1. Five numerical Q1 controls do not certify a resolved continuum reference or exact solution. Fixed macro8x8/P0-trace MHM r128-to-r256 increments remain about 3.6-3.7 percent in L2 and 19 percent in full broken H1. The MHM panels show local-resolution sensitivity across fixed trace partitions, not trace convergence or macro-mesh rates. Earlier r32/r64 diagnostic increments retain their own acquisition IDs and qualifications; producer generations are not retagged.

entries.title: Analytical Stokes, Brinkman and Oseen in 3D
entries.refinement: Macro n=1,2,3; Stokes TH P2/r2, Brinkman USFEM P1/r4 and P2/r2, Oseen P2/r2; triangular P1 skeleton
entries.summary: Separate velocity, pressure and velocity gradient errors decrease in all four fixed formulation series.
entries.limitations: Three initial levels do not establish asymptotic rates or uniform stability. The analytical unit-cube series is separate from a matched historical reproduction and independent native whole-case agreement.

entries.title: Nearly incompressible GaLS elasticity in 3D
entries.refinement: Macro n=1,2,3; GaLS P1/r4 and P2/r2, Taylor-Hood P2/r2; lambda=1e8 and variable shear
entries.summary: Displacement, Herrmann pressure, stress and displacement gradient errors decrease in all three fixed-space series.
entries.limitations: The three levels use one fixed nearly incompressible material; a locking sweep and uniform stability proof are outside this study. No matched historical table or independent native whole-case agreement is claimed.

entries.title: Weak-symmetry anisotropic elasticity in 2D
entries.refinement: Macro n=1,2,4; triangles/polygons BDM2/P1/P1, rectangles RT1/Q1/total-P1; r1; quadrature 8/9/10
entries.summary: Separate displacement, Cauchy stress, weak rotation and stress divergence errors decrease across all three families.
entries.limitations: Three initial levels do not establish every literature rate or uniform stability; triangular rotation has a measured last-step order of 1.319. Analytical anisotropic data are identified separately from historical paper data and independent native whole-case agreement.

entries.title: Anisotropic primal elasticity in 3D
entries.refinement: Macro n=1,2,3; selected primal P3/r1 finite space; analytical Kelvin stiffness (1+x+2y+3z)*SPD
entries.summary: Displacement errors decrease 1.0870 to 0.1244 and raw symmetric stress errors 102.23 to 26.98.
entries.limitations: This minimum series selects P3/r1; the P2/r2 family and extensive sweeps remain outside this acquisition. Raw symmetric stress and retained six rigid modes do not constitute an H(div) stress reconstruction or an independent native whole-case comparison.

entries.title: AFW weak-symmetry mixed elasticity in 3D
entries.refinement: Macro n=1,2,3; selected BDM3/P2/P2, local r1, triangular P2 negative-traction skeleton; incompressible lambda infinity
entries.summary: Displacement, physical Cauchy stress, axial weak rotation and stress divergence errors decrease over all three initial levels.
entries.limitations: The selected BDM3/P2/P2 series is an initial analytical AFW study; the BDM2/r2 family, locking sweep and complete historical tables remain outside this acquisition. Physical hydrostatic gauge and separate original blocks are checked; uniform stability and independent native whole-case agreement are not claimed.

entries.title: Analytical stabilized Stokes in 2D
entries.refinement: Macro n=2,4,8; selected USFEM P3/r1 with piecewise P1 pseudo-traction skeleton
entries.summary: Velocity, pressure, velocity gradient errors and divergence decrease over the three initial levels.
entries.limitations: This initial series selects trace P1; the P0/P2 trace variants remain outside this acquisition. Physical pressure mean and original field blocks are verified; no uniform stability proof, matched historical table or independent native whole-case agreement is claimed.

entries.title: Analytical Oseen with P1 skeleton in 2D
entries.refinement: Macro n=2,4,8; selected stabilized P3/r1, trace P1, smooth data and viscosity 1
entries.summary: Velocity, pressure, velocity gradient errors and divergence decrease over the three initial levels.
entries.limitations: This initial series selects trace P1; the P0/P2 trace variants remain outside this acquisition. Pseudo-traction and physical zero-mean pressure conventions are retained; no uniform stability or complete historical trace sweep is claimed.

entries.title: Analytical Oseen viscosity variants in 2D
entries.refinement: Macro n=2,4,8; stabilized P3/r1 with trace P1; selected viscosities 1 and 0.01
entries.summary: Velocity, pressure, velocity gradient errors and divergence decrease for both selected viscosities.
entries.limitations: The viscosity 1 acquisition UUIDs are reused from the trace-P1 study; these are the same executions, without retagging. The viscosity 0.0001 variant and extensive trace sweeps remain outside this initial acquisition; no uniform stability or matched full historical table is claimed.

entries.title: Oseen boundary, internal-layer and variable-advection data in 2D
entries.refinement: Macro n=2,4,8; stabilized P3/r1, trace P1; boundary-layer viscosity 0.01, internal-layer viscosity 0.001, variable-advection viscosity 1
entries.summary: Velocity, pressure and velocity gradient errors decrease in all three series; internal-layer divergence increases from 0.1926 to 0.2822.
entries.limitations: The internal-layer divergence does not converge on these three initial levels, despite accepted original discrete equation blocks. Sharp-layer velocity gradient errors remain large at the finest acquired level; smooth-problem rates and uniform stability are not inferred for these data. The selected trace-P1 analytical series does not reproduce all historical variants or establish independent native whole-case agreement.

entries.title: Oscillatory L18 mixed elasticity in 2D
entries.refinement: Fixed macro H=1/4 and 32 triangular macrocells; face segments s=1,2,4, local r=2s; BDM2/P1/P1, trace P1, enrichment 0
entries.summary: Displacement, Cauchy stress, weak rotation and stress divergence errors decrease for the original oscillatory geometry and data.
entries.limitations: The historical rotation column remains unreconciled; this selected BDM2 finite-space series is identified separately from a matched complete table reproduction. Three initial levels with assembly order 16 and norm orders 16/20 do not establish every asymptotic rate or uniform stability. Stress orders and rotation-enrichment sweeps, independent native whole-case comparison and coefficient field replay remain outside this scalar-record study.
